script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Market night, round three. I've been keeping notes: so far the crew has done tacos and viet there.

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Next on the list is burgers. There's a whole cluster of grill stalls by the fountain.

script.speaker: liam
script.text: BURGERS. cyrus i would follow your list off a cliff

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: grill stalls?? i'm down. i scouted that corner last week

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: cyrus, one grill there puts peanut sauce or crushed peanuts on basically everything. already crossed it off for you

script.speaker: mina
script.text: it's so nice to have all five of us tonight :) how's everyone's week been?

script.speaker: liam
script.text: my upstairs neighbour took up the trumpet. at 6am. every single day

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: bought a bike on monday and rode it straight into a hedge. the hedge is fine

script.speaker: mina
script.text: roxy!! a hedge?? please tell me you're okay

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: scraped knee, zero regrets. i'm riding it to the market tonight

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: Thank you for the scouting, Roxy. My week: I alphabetised my spice rack, then sorted it by cuisine, then put it back.

script.speaker: maya
script.text: cyrus that is the most cyrus sentence ever typed

script.speaker: maya
script.text: my week: the laundromat ate six of my quarters and i lost an argument with a machine

script.speaker: maya
script.text: so my wallet's in mourning. cheapest-stall prices tonight. a little over and i sulk the whole bus ride home. fancy prices and i'm turning around at the gate

script.speaker: liam
script.text: burger night means i'm on fries patrol. roxy, last time mina got a plate of fries while i had a double stack. this time she gets a burger with zero meat in it

script.speaker: mina
script.text: they were really good fries! but if you're patrolling, patrol roxy too. these grills love buttered buns and melted cheese, and remember the milkshake incident :)

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: i get my own PATROL?? honestly kind of honoured

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: assistant, pick us a stall. i'm on the bike, liam's on foot, may the best one win!!
